title: Happy New Year 2026 from FYI Yachts!
description: Discover the ultimate private sanctuary. Explore the Bugari F86 Seda, where Italian artistry meets a revolutionary main-deck master suite.
html:
As we welcome 2026, FYI Yachts extends our warmest wishes for a year filled with health, happiness, and abundance. Whether your goal is to purchase your first yacht, upgrade to a new vessel, or charter the perfect yacht to celebrate life’s special moments, our team is here to guide you every step of the way.

The New Year is an opportunity to turn aspirations into reality, and we are dedicated to ensuring your yachting experiences are truly exceptional. From celebrating the start of the year to marking birthdays, anniversaries, or simply enjoying the beauty of life on the water, we are ready to help make every moment unforgettable throughout the year.

As you chart your course forward, take inspiration from this verse:

“For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.” Jeremiah 29:11

At FYI Yachts, we believe in helping dreams take shape, both on and off the water. Let us make 2026 a year to remember. From our family to yours, may this year bring smooth sailing, new opportunities, and the fulfillment of your deepest aspirations. Happy New Year!
